thread:
rachel: heads-up — observed duplicate job records when sample-app switched to Go SDK. first submission ok, retry creates another job even though we set idempotency_key. server curl path dedupes correctly but sdk path didn't.

omar: can you repro and paste the curl + sdk payloads?

rachel: repro steps: curl (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/jobs \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"task":"index","idempotency_key":"abc-123"}'
```
returns 201 and subsequent identical call returns 200 with same job id (deduped). Go SDK call used:
```go
client.Jobs.Create(context.Background(), JobsCreateParams{Task: "index", IdempotencyKey: "abc-123"})
```
but when the client library retries (network hiccup) server created a second job.

tia: interesting. tcpdump shows curl sends idempotency_key in JSON body. Go SDK sends an HTTP header `X-Idempotency-Key: abc-123` and the JSON body omits the field. server dedupe logic looks only at body.idempotency_key for historical reasons.

kyle: that matches a generator mapping change we made last year: fields matching "idempotency" were annotated to move into headers for infra-level dedupe, but backend expects body-level key for job creation. two problems: 1) generator moved the field location; 2) retries don't replay the original header->body mapping consistently during auth refresh, so replay sometimes omits the header.

omar: so SDK both moved and split the key. That's bad for onboarding. sample-app uses idempotency everywhere.

rachel: reproduce: initial request failed during TLS handshake after header sent, client retried with the body-only form (no header) and server treated it as a fresh request. tcpdump shows mismatch.

tia: proposed fix: 1) revert generator mapping so JobsCreateParams serializes idempotency_key into the request body by default, 2) if we also send X-Idempotency-Key header, keep it in sync with body but don't rely on header alone, 3) ensure auth-refresh/retry replays the raw original request bytes rather than reserializing from a post-processed struct.

kyle: filing INF-3701 to track. I'll add a unit+integration test matrix that compares curl vs SDK payloads for create endpoints and verifies dedupe semantics across retries.

devx-bot: Created issue INF-3701: "Go SDK moved idempotency_key into header -> duplicate jobs on retry; replay mismatch" assigned to kyle.

kyle: PR 811 opened: generator tweak to keep idempotency_key in body, add header mirroring when present, fix auth replay to use raw request buffer, and add tests.

omar: can we ship a quickpatch? this blocks onboarding for a customer running sample-app in production.

kyle: I'll cut 0.7.4-hotfix with the minimum change (serialize idempotency_key into body and mirror to header) and include unit tests. full generator lint follow-up will come later. ETA ~ 40m.

tia: also add a short note in the SDK guide: "Idempotency: how SDK maps keys" and a curl vs SDK example so customers don't get surprised.

devx-bot: INF-3701 status -> in_progress, linked PR 811, release candidate 0.7.4-rc1.

kyle: released 0.7.4-hotfix. sample-app pinned to hotfix and customer onboarding no longer duplicates jobs. Closing INF-3701 after smoke tests pass.

rachel: verified on staging and prod for that customer — no duplicates anymore. thanks team :rocket:
